# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 c22 P10](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** General servant at the doctor's house (Hollowmere)  <sub>[v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is a lean, austere, and dark-featured woman who looks somewhat severe. She is fussy about her appearance when going out, having been seen wearing a stiffened pale print dress with a blue sash, beaded slippers, and a fancy hat with silk, lace, and blossoms. Her face is described as unlovely, and she has a distinct, sharp manner.

_Sources: [v4 c33 P15](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0015), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)_

## Personality

Tabitha is a fiercely loyal, practical, and hardworking woman who takes immense pride in her domestic duties, particularly her cooking and baking. Though she can be sharp-tongued, austere, and critical of others—especially men, whom she often views with suspicion—she possesses a deep, maternal affection for those in her care. She is fiercely protective of children, deeply devoted to Mrs. Doctor Carrow and her family, and holds firm, opinionated views on proper conduct and household management.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 c22 P10](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0010), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c2 P26](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0026), [v5 c2 P39](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0039)_

- Fiercely loyal and protective  <sub>[v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)</sub>
- House-proud and meticulous cook  <sub>[v4 c22 P10](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0010), [v4 c28 P18](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0018)</sub>
- Sharp-tongued and opinionated  <sub>[v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v5 c2 P26](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0026)</sub>

## Abilities

- Expert cooking and baking  <sub>[v4 c22 P10](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0010), [v4 c28 P18](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To faithfully serve and protect the Carrow household and children  <sub>[v4 c19 P18](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0018), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)</sub>
- To maintain proper order and cleanliness in the home  <sub>[v4 c28 P18](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0018), [v5 c10 P34](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0034)</sub>

## History

Tabitha initially worked as a general servant at Miss Rosalind Pembroke's stone house, Echo Cottage, where she helped entertain guests and keep the house in order. She later took a position as the general servant for Dr. Hugh Carrow and Nell Harcourt at their house of dreams in Seven Gulls, managing the household with efficiency and strict care. When Nell gave birth to her children, Tabitha helped nurse Nell back to health after a life-threatening illness, becoming particularly devoted to her son Harcourt ('the little brown boy'). When Hugh and Nell relocated their family to Hollowmere at Glen St. Agnes, Tabitha moved with them, continuing her rule over the kitchen and raising the Carrow children with a mix of strict discipline and fierce, protective love.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 c19 P2](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0002), [v4 c19 P18](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0018), [v4 c28 P18](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0018), [v4 c40 P42](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0042), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Never had a suitor or proposal in her youth  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 c22 P10](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0010)</sub>
- Had an uncle who was a failed poet and became a vagrant
- Had a sister named Matilda who married James Clow  <sub>[v4 c22 P1](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0001), [v4 c35 P18](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0018)</sub>

## Quotes

> No goose ever existed that was so gray that, sooner or later, some honest gander did not come along and take her to be his mate!  <sub>[v4 c22 P9](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0009)</sub>

> Owning a dog is pointless if you bark yourself.  <sub>[v4 c23 P28](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0028)</sub>

> Mrs. Dr. dear, I brought him into this world every bit as much as you. The baby belongs to me every bit as much as he belongs to you.  <sub>[v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)</sub>

> I was never had by a beau, let alone two, and it does not bother me now, because being an old maid fails to hurt once you grow accustomed to it.  <sub>[v5 c1 P10](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0010)</sub>
